name: labs/liamsgithub__as7265x-spectrometer
title: SparkFun Triad AS7265x spectrometer
intro: SparkFun Triad AS7265x spectrometer, adapted from liamsgithub/as7265x-spectrometer. It reads `board_present`, `hardware_version`, `temperatures` and `measure_intensity`; sets `integration_time_register`, `gain`, `led_drive_current`, `blue_led` and 1 more; runs `read_spectrum`, `factory_reset` and `leds_off`. `read_spectrum`: read all 18 raw and all 18 calibrated channel values in the ascending-frequency order of the clone. A hardware driver: the market serves its fake backend, so no instrument is needed.
